name: Pit Trap, Deathfall (CR 14)
body:
Deathfall Pit
CR 14

XP 38,400

Type mechanical; Perception DC 30; Disable Device DC 30

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset manual

Effect 60-ft.-deep pit (6d6 falling damage; DC 20 Reflex avoids); ghoulish arms erupt from the walls of the pit to attack all creatures within the pit (Atk +20 melee, 2 attacks per target for 1d6+13 damage plus paralysis for 1d4+1 rounds [Fort DC 20 negates paralysis], claws attack each round); multiple targets (all targets in a 10-ft.-square area)
